title: The shortest day
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The shortest day. The seawall at four, already dark. Wood and the dog. The strip draws the dark as a panel that is mostly black with a coat in it and a dog in it and the sign across the road, and then the same panel three more times with the dark a little more each. The year, going.

panels.composition: The seawall at four PM, December 21, the light going. WOOD in the coat from behind, BARNABY. The sign across the road lit. Mostly black.

image.prompt: a seawall at four in the afternoon on the shortest day with the light going, a man in a coat from behind and a small dog, a distant lit sign, the panel mostly black, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The same. Darker. The coat a shape.

image.prompt: the same seawall scene darker, the coat now a shape, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The same. Darker. The coat gone into the dark; the dog a lighter shape; the sign.

image.prompt: the same seawall scene nearly black with a small pale dog shape and a distant lit sign, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Black. The sign's fifteen letters, tiny, across the road. Nothing else. The year, going. The strip lets it.

image.prompt: a nearly black panel with only a distant row of tiny lit letters, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Four panels darkening to the sign. The year, going.
